content: प्रव्रज्या .²1 Going abroad, migration. .²2 Roaming, wandering about as a religious mendicant; अतश्च प्रव्रज्यासुलभसमयाचारविमुखः . प्रसक्तस्ते यत्नः … <ls>Māl. 4. 6</ls>. .²3 The order of a religious mendicant, a mendicantʼs life, the fourth (or भिक्षु) order in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa; प्रव्रज्यां कल्पवृक्षा इवाश्रिताः <ls>Ku. 6. 6</ls>. (where <ls>Malli.</ls> says प्रव्रज्या means the वानप्रस्थ or third order).
